Plot features over time as horizon strips

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/plotHorizon.R, R/zzz-mae.R
plotHorizon.Rd

plotHorizon() draws one strip per feature. Each value is centred, cut into bands bands of equal height and the bands are overlaid, so that deviations above and below the centre show as darker reds and blues in a short strip.

plotHorizon(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plotHorizon(
  x,
  time.col,
  group = NULL,
  assay.type = "counts",
  features = NULL,
  top = 20,
  bands = 3,
  centre = c("median", "baseline", "mean"),
  level = c("subject", "group"),
  group.by = NULL,
  max.gap = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'MultiAssayExperiment'
plotHorizon(x, ..., experiment = 1L)

Arguments

x

a SummarizedExperiment object.

...

additional arguments passed to geom_ribbon.

time.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains sampling times: numeric, Date, POSIXct or a factor of visits. Time differences, as in max.gap, are in days for Date and hours for POSIXct times.

group

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that identifies subjects. If NULL, all samples form one series. (Default: NULL)

assay.type

Character scalar. Specifies the assay to plot. (Default: "counts")

features

Character vector. Features to plot. If NULL, plots the top features with the largest mean. (Default: NULL)

top

Integer scalar. Number of features to plot when features is NULL. (Default: 20)

bands

Integer scalar. Number of bands on each side of the centre. (Default: 3)

centre

Character scalar. Centres each series on its median ("median"), its first value ("baseline") or its mean ("mean"). (Default: "median")

level

Character scalar. Draws one column of strips per subject ("subject") or averages the subjects of each group.by group at each time ("group"). (Default: "subject")

group.by

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that groups subjects when level = "group". If NULL, all subjects form one group. (Default: NULL)

max.gap

Numeric scalar. Breaks a strip where consecutive samples of a subject are further apart than this, in time.col units. For visits, NULL breaks strips at visits without a sample; otherwise NULL never breaks strips. (Default: NULL)

experiment

Character scalar or integer scalar. For a MultiAssayExperiment, the experiment to plot; its samples get the colData of x. (Default: 1L)

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The band height of a feature is its largest absolute deviation from the centre, over all subjects, divided by bands; strips of a feature are comparable across subjects, not across features. Visits are evenly spaced.

References

Fink I, et al. (2022). BiomeHorizon: visualizing microbiome time series data in R. mSystems 7(3):e01380-21.

Examples

# 16 species in three bioreactors
data("minimalgut", package = "miaTime")
tse <- mia::transformAssay(minimalgut, method = "relabundance")
plotHorizon(tse, time.col = "Time.hr", group = "StudyIdentifier",
    assay.type = "relabundance", top = 8)


# Deviation from the first sample, averaged over the bioreactors
plotHorizon(tse, time.col = "Time.hr", group = "StudyIdentifier",
    assay.type = "relabundance", top = 8, centre = "baseline",
    level = "group")
